Zoe Chen: Quick sync — NorthStar QBR is Tue May 12. Need final slide set by Mon EOD. Specifically: onboarding status slide (activation %, stuck accounts), renewal risk heatmap, and exec talking points. Who can own slide 3-6?

Alex Martinez: I can take onboarding slide (slide 3). Will pull activation numbers.

Maya Patel: I'll own renewal heatmap (slide 4). Need churn-risk list + top 5 at-risk accounts.

Samir Rao: I can do exec talking points (slide 5). Can someone share recent CSAT snippets?

Olivia Park: @Alex can you include the 30-day activation metric? Also add trial->paid conversion per cohort.

Alex Martinez: Yep. Query I use:
```
SELECT cohort_week, cnt_active, cnt_signed
FROM onboarding_metrics
WHERE event_time > now() - interval '30 days'
ORDER BY cohort_week;
```
Will paste numbers by 3pm.

Maya Patel: For risk list, can you export renewal dates + ARR + last_contact? I can map to heatmap.

Zoe Chen: @Maya pls include renewal likelihood tag (green/amber/red) per CSM assessment.

csm-bot: Reminder: QBR deck deadline Monday 17:00 PT. Attachments: none. :bell:

Samir Rao: Exec dry-run Thursday 9am PT — calendar invite sent to exec-alias. Need 10-min run + 5-min Qs.

Olivia Park: Also recommend we add 1 slide for enablement asks (training, playbooks) — customers keep asking for deeper onboarding labs.

Maya Patel: noted. @Olivia can you draft enablement asks bullet list? I can incorporate in the deck.

Olivia Park: On it. Draft in this thread by EOD.

Alex Martinez: Pushed numbers to the slides: https://go.redwood/slides/NorthStar-QBR (please check slide 3). I added a small note about cohort lag.

Zoe Chen: Thanks. @Samir I'll drop executive bullets in slide notes as soon as you share main points.

Samir Rao: Draft bullets:
- 3 key wins (performance, adoption, case studies)
- 2 friction areas (onboarding time, billing clarity)
- 1 ask (pilot dedicated capacity for X)
Will DM more specifics.

Maya Patel: Uploaded heatmap csv to drive: https://go.redwood/drive/NS-heatmap.csv — columns: account, ARR, renewal_date, last_contact, risk_tag

Olivia Park: Quick ask — can someone pull the 90-day support ticket trend for NorthStar? Need to show trendline.

Alex Martinez: I'll add ticket trend. SQL:
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as day, count(*) as tickets
FROM support_tickets
WHERE account = 'NorthStar' AND created_at > now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day;
```

- [ ] Ticket trend + activation numbers (Alex)
